ui_bugs.issue: Missing 'seg-blacklist' card. Task spec called for 5 segment cards (active, vip, inactive, blacklist, nouvelles) + 'all'. Code SEGMENTS array only contains 5 (all, active, inactive, vip, nouvelles) — blacklist omitted. Backend supports segment='blacklist' in _segment_filter so this is a UI gap only.

design_issues.screen: Multiple (Dashboard PeriodSelector, Referrals ApplyModal customer select)
issues: Persistent React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' coming from devtools instrumentation inserting <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option>. Cosmetic console noise; same warning carried over from iteration_5. No functional impact.

action_items: (LOW) Add 'blacklist' entry to SEGMENTS array in /app/frontend/src/pages/console/WhatsAppCampaigns.jsx line 7 if business wants to broadcast to blacklisted customers; otherwise document intentional exclusion.
critical_code_review_comments: _wa_message_for_status: duplicate 'confirmee' branch at line 427 (if status == 'confirmee' or 'nouvelle': return None) is dead code — the earlier 'if status == confirmee' at line 412 already returns. Harmless but confusing; remove line 427-428.

_enqueue_wa silently drops messages when the customer has no phone_digits. Fine, but no telemetry — operators won't know messages failed to enqueue for n customers in broadcast. Consider counting skipped and returning it alongside 'enqueued'.

/attendance/punch-kiosk has no rate limiting — a malicious actor could brute-force 4-digit PINs. With only 10 000 combinations and 5 known PINs this is weak. Recommend adding IP-based rate limit (e.g., 5 attempts / minute) before go-live.

/whatsapp-outbox endpoints (list, mark-sent) require only authenticated user; any role (incl. rider) can see all broadcast messages containing full customer phone numbers. Consider gating to admin/manager/sales.
/customer-segments uses 'last_order_at' field but there is no index — on large customer collections this will be slow. Add index on last_order_at + created_at.
DEFAULT_LOYALTY tier threshold for Silver (500 pts) collides with VIP segment threshold (>500 pts) in _segment_filter. Consistent branding is fine but worth confirming intent.

Referral apply: no transaction/atomicity — if the 2nd update_one or referrals.insert_one fails after the parrain wallet is incremented, the state is inconsistent. Low probability in Mongo but worth noting.
